title: gpu-ops-daily-scratchpad-03
content:
Quick notes / running TODOs for GPU ops (personal scratchpad)

2026-03-04 morning:
- Check cluster capacity before doll-out: expected traffic spike Tue-Wed (marketing demo)
- Current GPU pool utilization: rough check shows 78% across g4/g5 pools (quick query on prometheus)
- Priority: ensure can shave 10% cost by moving low-priority realtime jobs to spot/dedicated burst policy

Immediate tasks:
- [ ] Reimage node g2-05 (OOM kernel panics last night) -> coordinate with SRE to drain, reprovision, rejoin. Ticket: JIRA-OPS-1298
  - quick commands: kubectl drain g2-05 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
  - snapshot logs: /var/log/journal (grab last 200 lines)
- [ ] Redeploy quantized-runtime 1.4.2 to dedicated pool alpha (canary on 2 nodes)
  - rollout plan: canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% if latency stable
  - metrics to watch: p99 latency, token-per-second, oom/restarts
- [ ] Validate network rules for private VPC customer (acct: acme-corp) after last firewall change (JIRA-NET-442)
  - confirm egress rules still allow KMS and control-plane endpoints
  - check VPC peering route tables and NAT gateway health

Notes / Observations:
- Prefix cache hit rates dropped 4% after the optimizer change last week; could be due to changed prompt formatting from demo clients. Need regression test set.
- Spot interruptions: increase graceful retry/backoff for low-priority batch jobs (Samir offered a small patch)
- Kernel upgrades scheduled next Tue for g5 fleet; need to freeze any infra deploys 24h prior

Follow-ups / reminders:
- Ping Lina for Dedicated billing reconciliation (overrun on committed hours)
- Add quick runbook blurb for node reimage: steps + common pitfalls (will draft in Confluence)
- Short postmortem draft for g2-05 OOM; include top-of-file command outputs and OOM killer lines

Commands & quick queries I use often:
- prometheus: sum(rate(gpu_utilization[5m])) by (pool)
- k8s: kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep g2-
- logs: journalctl -u inference-runtime --since "2 hours ago" | tail -n 200

Today focus order:
1) Reimage g2-05 and verify rejoin (blocks other work)
2) Start canary deploy for quantized-runtime 1.4.2 (alpha pool)
3) Validate ACME VPC egress rules and confirm KMS reachability

Random notes to self:
- Keep a short list of safe rollback artifacts for every release (image tag + config snapshot)
- Remind product: demo uses longer prompts -> cost impact; ask for smaller sample set for stress tests
- If capacity > 85% for 3 consecutive hours, trigger auto-scale-up policy review

End of scratchpad for now — will copy important items to team notes and Jira tasks.
